campaign: GNSS spoof bounded response: zero horizontal velocity hold instead of hard rejection
evidence_level: L2 (real firmware + 6DOF plant + sensor models, SIL only)
scenario: 30 m hover, pos-hold at 20 s, 10 m N leg, spoof at 25 s, 45 s; 6 dirs x 10 seeds, response off/on same binary
response: detect >=25 m inter-epoch position residual; do not reject GNSS; set position-hold velocity target to zero (1 m/s^2 cap), keep AUTO_POSITION/altitude/EKF fusion; 10 s hold after detection
verdict: Mixed/not adopted. Response lowers median true displacement (30/50/100 m: 24.4/29.6/30.6 -> 15.9/15.9/16.1 m) but worsens p95/max (30 m max 56.7 -> 61.7; 100 m max 55.4 -> 71.0), and does not reduce EKF position error (pos_rms unchanged). It is a control trade, not a spoof fix; without external reference the spoofed coordinate remains accepted. Code was reverted; default behavior remains the existing NIS/reanchor bounded response.
caveats: No false trigger on normal flight or 20 m steps (det=0, identical behavior).
Without flow, zero-velocity hold cannot stop slow IMU/velocity drift; tails worsen in some seeds.
All numbers are scalar-Eigen SIL L2, not real aircraft.
